Pounce of the Red Claw

You gather yourself low and spring with a hunter’s sudden certainty.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Agility

Target / range / shape: One creature reachable by a legal move of up to 2 squares.

Claws or a fleeting beast-shape carry you into the leap. Move up to 2 squares, then strike an adjacent target; no prior transformation is required. Movement provokes normally.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 4 physical damage and knock prone. - Strong: 6 physical damage and knock prone; move 1 square without provoking afterward.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Wilderness 2 and Athletics 1

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: pounce-of-the-red-claw
